notes: The cognate infinitive absolute אָרוֹר takes the distinct adverbial word *bitterly* spent on its emphasis and heads on it, the finite imperative keeping *Curse ye* (rule 56).
יֹשְׁבֶיהָ divides into the anarthrous substantival participle with its supplied *the* (rule 46) and the suffix realized by *thereof* (rule 18).
Margin *Or, among* read and set aside (rule 38).
